record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, scale only real history input embeddings by 1+0.03*min(n_t,20)/20, where n_t counts observed real items through position t. This causal prefix-length feature may distinguish established context from short prefixes without relying on repeated items. Keep padding zero, candidate embeddings unchanged, and preserve embedding parameterization, GRU topology, readout, loss and optimizer. Apply identical feature construction in the predictor writer.

category_rationales.rationale: Test a mild causal prefix-length feature across all four datasets: amplify real history inputs by up to 3% as observed context grows. Padding remains zero and candidate embeddings remain unchanged. The embedded predictor imports the modified model; matching metadata validation ensures consistent inference without changing learned embeddings, GRU topology, readout, loss, or optimizer.
